test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six people are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. S, T and U are seated in the same row facing south. X, Y and Z are seated in the same row facing north. U sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite X. T is the immediate neighbour of U and sits exactly opposite Z. Who sits at the extreme right end of the row facing North?
solution:
Given:

Six people are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people each.

S, T and U are seated in the same row facing south. X, Y, and, Z are seated in the same row facing north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90ca454f9d01cee43544bfe28c7d3b2eb071c44ed3033766e47f94b26645d10d.png] 

U sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite X.

T is the immediate neighbour of U and sits exactly opposite Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aee064f5465d883ff53439ddb69d7df8da05bec5ccf59a7e4afbb0a0bb9ebbf7.png] 

According to the arrangement, **Y is sitting at the extreme right end of the row facing North**.

Hence, the correct answer is __'**option 2'**__.
